title: ModbusToolRead
description: The registers modbus-tool read from one device at a given offset.

Result.description: Success if the device answered the read, otherwise Failure.

Reason.description: Why the read failed. Present only on Failure.

Offset.description: Offset of the first register read, in hex.

Size.description: Number of 16-bit registers asked for, read in a single request.

Raw.description: The values read, one hex string per register, starting with the register at Offset. Holds Size entries on Success, and is empty on Failure.
